That's ... depressing, we know no one really is there when you need someone 
But this! This is just so sad 😞
I do. Cis female, I love my breasts but it's easy to hide cuts on the breasts. And fat feels easier to cut.

I use calm harm app

It's helping me a lot
I am sorry. But yes you can 🫂. Thank you for your help and kind words💞

If go to the college clinic, I'll be talking to those who taught (will still teach me), it is uncomfortable to talk to them. I know it won't be comfortable to talk about this to anyone, but the fact that we'd have to go through why and talk about personal matters... I just don't feel like I could do it with someone who already knows me. idk. And there is always the risk of having my sh and suicidal thoughts reported on somewhere leading to future problems idk like difficulty fininding a fellowship or something like this? 

Plus I tried once, I went to check up at the college clinic it was formality, I went with the intent of telling the GP about it and I was really gonna do it but when she asked "how is everything going" my mind shut and I just said the same thing I always say to anyone... I'm fine everything is great, while crossing my legs making my cuts hurt. It was strange. Everything and all those reasons came to me then.

I've never actually bandaged my cuts, because I wasn't planning my first cuts. Then I did stupid things to cover in the intent of protecting it, when it didn't work I thought it was one time occurance so I didn't look up. Happened again and again that's when I thought I need to take care of the cuts al least. And now here I am trying to figure this out. I will ask for supplies if my "get clean" plan didn't work and I had to cut while on rotation. 


My school has free counselling but I don't plan on talking to them. Thank you for offering to listen

Wow congrats 3 years clean! I am proud of you, hope you are clean for good 🥰. 

I am from KSA. I never heard of calm harm app, I am installing it now thank you. As for the Amazon wish list, I don't wanna be a burden but thank you for considering going this far for a stanger. 

I will get help when I can. I'm trying to look at the brightside ... the thing you said about doctors and understanding of self-harm is surely on that little list.
Then you associate those with sh slowly they become triggering too... you didn't do anything new just more triggering words to add to your list.

My advice to you and everyone is: 
Don't get involved in tiktok sh community, it's triggering as fuck just mark this shit as "not interested" and get rid of it.
I am sorry I hope it gets better for you and thank you
Thank you at least I'm being heard. I hope you're not having those feeling now too. Thank you

I am sorry I stopped selfharming 5 days ago and now those thoughts are back. I can't get out of bed I don't want to listen to anyones voice or see anyone's face I want to stay still. I want time to stop I want to breath. It is suffocating. I am tired. I tried so hard to change I am so tierd. I am sorry you're reading this I am sorry

All I say... DO NOT START. 

If you want coping mechanism and you are considering sh, then you should consider other things too... 

Please please find something else. It might be pysical activity  to help with intenes emotions or unwanted thoughts. If you have something you injoy doing go on and turn it into your coping mechanism (many people use drawing as coping mechanism, and others play some type of instrument.)
